posts.title: Springtime Walk in Manhattan

posts.title: ‘Wild Horse Nine’ – Film Review and Analysis
posts.description: "Beneath its dark humor, Wild Horse Nine is a multifaceted story about living with past regrets, seeking redemption before it’s too late, and trusting your friends to do the right thing, even when it costs you everything."

posts.title: When Respect Has Rules – Why Standards Still Matter in Sacred Spaces
posts.description: "With standards, norms, and basic courtesy often increasingly disregarded in shared public settings, from libraries and Metro stations to the workplace, we should make a particular effort to uphold them in the places dedicated to worship, remembrance, and reflection."
